name: 6-Can Chicken Tortilla Soup
desc: Dump-and-go soup of canned chicken, corn, black beans and green chile tomatoes, simmered with taco spices.

source.title: Six Can Chicken Tortilla Soup
source.evidence: Same five canned ingredients in the same sizes (corn, 2 cans broth, chunk chicken, black beans, tomatoes with green chiles); this version adds cumin, chili powder, taco seasoning and optional cream of chicken soup.

ingredients.raw: 1 (15 oz) can whole kernel corn, drained
1 (10 oz) can chunk chicken, with its liquid
1 (10 oz) can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, drained
ingredients.item: diced tomatoes with green chile peppers

ingredients.raw: 1 (10.5 oz) can condensed cream of chicken soup (optional, for a creamier soup)
ingredients.note: 10.5 oz; optional, for a creamier soup

ingredients.raw: Salt and black pepper, to taste

steps: Pour the corn, chicken broth, chunk chicken (break up any large pieces), black beans with their liquid, and drained diced tomatoes with green chiles into a large saucepan or stockpot. Stir in the cream of chicken soup if using.
Stir in the cumin, chili powder, and taco seasoning.
Bring to a simmer over medium heat and cook, stirring occasionally, until the soup is steaming hot throughout, about 15 minutes. Taste and season with salt and pepper.
Ladle into bowls and top with crushed tortilla chips, cilantro, and a spoonful of sour cream.
tips: The Allrecipes original tops each bowl with tortilla chips and shredded Cheddar; add a handful of Cheddar if you like.
